title: 第5章 打的就是你
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
两个月来，方行每天都要吃掉十多斤的肉类，这还不包括其他的米饭、瓜果以及各种酒水，偶尔还会买些滋补类的药材滋养身体。在这样的环境，王志等五个道童跟着方行，雨露均沾，一个个吃的满脸红光，膘肥体壮，就连小肚子都起来了，下巴叠了两三层。
可是方行却没有变胖，甚至还瘦了些。
如今他的体魄看起来甚是单薄，纸片子一样，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒。
然而他的眼睛却变得非常明亮，精神状态极好，一举一动，都满蕴着力量感。
“这青云造化经果然非同寻常，我只修炼了两个月，便有了如此变化，也难怪当初我那九个叔叔都号称自己是江湖上拔尖的好手，却被一鹰一剑，杀的干干净净……”
药田旁边的山林之中，方行坐在一堆篝火前，望着火堆架着一只野兔出神。
两个月来的大吃大喝，方行从众道童们手里搜刮来的银两早就挥霍一空了，没钱怎么办？
总不能真教这几个家伙去卖屁股，而且凭他这熊样，估计也没人肯买。
没办法，方行就经常带着几个道童到附近的山林里来打猎，青云山附近的山林，野兽颇多，也不勒禁道童们的捕捉，只要有本事，就可以来捉一些改善生活。
好在，在他修成了一道灵气之后，便感觉自己耳聪目敏，反应极快，就连手劲也大了很多。
平时捡一堆小石子在怀里，一旦发现有野兔、野鸡之类的飞起，挨手就打，三十丈内，无有不中。
甚至还有一次，方行独自碰到了一头野狼，挨了它两口之后，硬生生让方行拽住了狼尾，然后跳上狼背，一阵子黑拳，活活给打死了。
在方行小小的身子扛着一只野狼回到木屋时，王志等人都快吓尿了。
从那时起，方行在他们心里便宛若天人，一个个就差立誓效忠了。
方行对他们自然也不错，匪窝里养出来的豪侠脾性，并没有因为外表的年龄而减弱半点。
有肉一起吃，有酒一起喝，不能喝就捏着鼻子灌。
如今，“方老大”这个称呼，已经深植于五个道童心里，不再只是口头说说了。
“我现在的灵力已经能够成功运转一个周天了，也不知道算不算达到灵动一重了！”
方行心里嘀咕着，按照青云山道门的规定，诸道童修炼到了灵动一重的境界，就可以晋升为外门弟子，身份上提高了一个等阶，也不用在这片药田里胡混了，据说还有些其他的好处，只不过，青云锻气篇上说了如何修炼，却没说如何划分修为的等级。
也正是因此，方行如今也不知道怎么算什么境界。

“方老大，柴禾捡回来了……”
不远处一排松树后面，王志带着小雀斑笑嘻嘻的走了过来，一人肩上担着一捆干柴。
平时灵田那边不能断了人，因此五个道童都是轮换着跟方行出来打猎，这一次跟着方行出来的就是王志和小雀斑，刚才看着柴禾不够了，方行就让他们两个去拾点柴禾，这才回来。
要说方行成了这丙字三号田的老大之后，最大的改变就是小雀斑等人的待遇好了，以前他们是挨王志的欺负，虽然只有五个人，却是等级分明，你欺负我欺负他，不过方行来了之后，就简单多了，所有人都得挨我的欺负，其他人不许耍横，就一起干活，一起吃饭。
每当王志下意识的想指使小雀斑或吊死鬼的时候，方行就一脚踹了过去，如此过了三个月，王志已经很习惯自己洗臭袜子了。
当然了，除了自己的袜子，方行的袜子也得是他们几个轮着洗的。
“砍个柴还磨磨叽叽，火都灭了，快滚过来！”
见方老大发火了，王志与小雀斑急忙快步跑了过来，然后看着火堆上的野兔子流口水。
认了方行做老大之后，这道门的清贫生活终于一去不返，油水丰富的很。
七手八脚把野兔烤熟了，正撕下来分肉，忽然不远处一个匆匆忙忙的身影跑了过来，口中叫道：“不好啦，方师兄，上面带着人来灵药田检查了，见你们不在，正在发火……”
众人抬头一看，却是留下来看药田的吊死鬼，满脸焦急的跑了过来。
“巡检的日子不是明天吗？怎么今天就来了？”
“我也不清楚，好像是一个姓余的师兄路过，就想起了过来瞧瞧……”

content_en:
For two months, Fang Xing ate more than ten kilograms of meat every day, not including other rice, fruits, and various drinks. He occasionally bought some nourishing medicinal materials to nourish his body. In such an environment, Wang Zhi and other five Taoist boys followed Fang, covered in rain and dew. Their faces were all rosy after eating, and their bodies were fat and strong. Even their bellies were bulging, and their chins were folded two or three times.
But Fang Xing did not gain weight, and even lost some weight.
Now his body looks very thin, like a piece of paper, as if it could be blown down by a gust of wind.
However, his eyes became very bright, his mental state was excellent, and every move he made was filled with a sense of power.
"This Qingyun Creation Sutra is indeed extraordinary. I have only practiced for two months and I have undergone such a change. It is no wonder that all nine of my uncles claimed to be the best in the world, but they were all killed by an eagle and a sword..."
In the forest next to the medicine field, Fang Xing sat in front of a bonfire, looking at a hare on the fire in trance.
After two months of eating and drinking, Fang Xing had already squandered all the money he had collected from the Taoist boys. What would he do if he had no money?
You can't really teach these guys to sell their butts, and with his bad behavior, no one is likely to buy them.
There was no other way, so Fang Xing often took several Taoist boys to hunt in the nearby mountains and forests. There were many wild beasts in the mountains and forests near Qingyun Mountain, and the Taoist boys were not restricted from catching them. As long as they had the ability, they could catch some to improve their lives.
Fortunately, after he cultivated a spiritual energy, he felt that his ears and eyes were sharp, his reactions were extremely fast, and even his hand strength was much stronger.
I usually pick up a pile of pebbles in my arms. Once I find a hare, pheasant or the like flying up, I will hit them with my hands, and I will hit everything within thirty feet.
There was even one time when Fang Xing met a wild wolf alone. After being bitten by it twice, he forcefully let Fang Xing grab the wolf's tail, then jumped on the wolf's back and beat him to death with a series of black punches.
When Fang Xing returned to the cabin carrying a wild wolf on his small body, Wang Zhi and others were almost scared to death.
From then on, Fang Xing was like a heavenly being in their hearts, and they almost swore allegiance to him.
Fang Xing was naturally good to them. The heroic temperament raised in the gangster den did not weaken at all because of his appearance.
Eat meat together and drink wine together. If you can't drink, just hold your nose and drink it.
Nowadays, the title "Boss Fang" has been deeply rooted in the hearts of the five Taoist boys, and is no longer just spoken.
"My spiritual power can now be successfully circulated for a week. I don't know if I have reached the first level of spiritual power!"
Fang Xing murmured in his heart. According to the regulations of Qingyun Mountain Taoist Sect, Taoist boys can be promoted to outer sect disciples after they have reached the first level of agility. Their status will be raised by one level, and they no longer have to mess around in this medicine field. It is said that there are other benefits. However, the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter talks about how to practice, but it does not say how to divide the levels of cultivation.
It is precisely because of this that Fang Xing doesn't know what state he is in now.
"Boss Fang, I picked up the firewood..."
Not far away, behind a row of pine trees, Wang Zhi walked over with a smile on his face, carrying a bundle of dry firewood on his shoulders.
Normally, people could not be cut off at Lingtian, so the five Taoist boys took turns to go hunting with Fang Xing. This time, Wang Zhi and Xiao Freckles followed Fang Xing. They saw that there was not enough firewood just now, so Fang Xing asked the two of them to pick up some firewood before returning.
The biggest change after Fang Xing became the boss of No. 3 Tian C is that the treatment of Xiao Freckles and others has improved. In the past, they were bullied by Wang Zhi. Although there were only five people, they were hierarchical. You bullied me and bullied him. But after Fang Xing came, it became much easier. Everyone had to be bullied by me. Others were not allowed to act arrogant, so we worked and ate together.
Whenever Wang Zhi subconsciously wants to instruct Xiaofreckles or hang someone, Fang XingSo he kicked her away. After three months of this, Wang Zhi was already very used to washing smelly socks by himself.
Of course, in addition to his own socks, Fang Xing's socks also had to be washed by several of them in turn.
"Chopping wood and grinding, the fire is extinguished, come here quickly!"
Seeing that Boss Fang was angry, Wang Zhi and Xiao Freckles ran over quickly, and then looked at the wild rabbit on the fire and drooled.
After recognizing Fang Xing as the boss, the poverty-stricken life of this family was finally gone forever, and it became very rich.
They cooked the hare with all their hands and were tearing it off and dividing the meat. Suddenly, a hurried figure not far away ran over and shouted: "It's not good, Senior Brother Fang. The superiors brought people to the elixir field to check. Seeing that you are not here, they are getting angry..."
Everyone looked up and saw that the hanged man who had stayed to look at the medicine field ran over with anxious expressions on his face.
"Isn't the inspection day tomorrow? Why are you here today?"
"I don't know. It seems that a senior brother named Yu was passing by and thought of coming over to take a look..."
